description: Pre-registered Phase 5 evaluation endpoints. Frozen before any modelling code exists; do not change after model fitting starts. This file is authoritative.

response.observed: per held-out target and condition: target - NTC pseudobulk mean of log1p CP10k on the evaluation cells
response.predicted: the model's predicted mean change for the same target, condition and genes

evaluation_cells.rule: Calibrate the held-out target's delta on calib_fold k (its own expression only) and evaluate on calib_fold 1-k, for k = 0 and 1. NTC cells use the same whole-well split. Calibration and evaluation cells never overlap.
evaluation_cells.combine_directions: per-target metrics are averaged over the 2 directions (Pearson r on the Fisher z scale)

gene_set.genes: network panel genes, fixed from training data only (training-fold targets plus NTC) before evaluation

primary.endpoint: held-out prediction of perturbation-induced downstream expression changes

averaging.rule: per held-out target z = mean(atanh(r_DMSO), atanh(r_Vem)); NaN if either condition is undefined

effect_size.definition: median of Walsh averages of the paired differences
effect_size.scale: Fisher z for Pearson r, reported back-transformed with tanh; native units for RMSE
effect_size.applies_to: every Wilcoxon test: primary, per-condition, RMSE and secondary comparisons

nan_rule.undefined: a constant prediction has undefined Pearson r, recorded as NaN; RMSE is always defined
nan_rule.flag_rule: flag the result in the summary if any model has NaN for more than 10% of targets

noise_ceiling.role: supporting context reported next to each target's model r
noise_ceiling.halves: target evaluation cells and NTC evaluation cells are split separately into random halves
noise_ceiling.statistic: Pearson r between the two half-sample target - NTC change vectors over the panel genes (perturbed gene excluded)
noise_ceiling.summary: median over splits per target, condition and cross-fit direction; directions averaged on the Fisher z scale

supporting: median over held-out targets (back-transformed r; RMSE)
per-condition Wilcoxon signed-rank on z (DMSO, Vem)

comparators.note: Pearson r is undefined for a constant zero prediction

secondary_comparisons.test: same paired Wilcoxon signed-rank with Hodges-Lehmann effect size

secondary_endpoint.prediction: apply the frozen Phase 2 scoring (same program genes, background controls, DMSO NTC center and scale) to the predicted expression changes; the score is linear in log expression, so the predicted mean effect is that linear combination of predicted gene changes. Genes a model does not predict get a predicted change of 0 for every model alike.
secondary_endpoint.summary: median absolute error over held-out targets; paired Wilcoxon signed-rank vs shared CSCN-SEM with Hodges-Lehmann effect size

heterogeneity_calibration.rule: the predicted between-cell dispersion (log variance ratio) must not exceed the upper bound of the observed 95% interval
metrics: over_dispersion_rate (share of target x condition rows above the upper bound; nominal <= 0.025)

tertiary_endpoints.models_without_cell_level_output: observed evaluation-fold control cells plus the model's predicted mean shift
tertiary_endpoints.power_note: Phase 2 found 0 pre-specified primary dispersion calls (Fufa log variance ratio BH q < 0.05 with mean CI including 0) across 56 targets x 2 conditions; tertiary endpoints are expected to have low power (see results/summary/phase2b_power_summary.md).

leakage: Targets are split into train / held-out before any response-based step (config/target_split.json).
Structure, SEM coefficients, NMF, scaling, gene selection and hyperparameters use training data only.
Target calibration (delta) uses the held-out target's own expression only, from the calibration fold.
Only perturbation-induced changes are evaluated; the perturbed gene is excluded.
All models share features, calibration information and splits.
